/**
 * Sample source file for the RAGLab code chunker golden test (self-written, MIT).
 * A tiny tree table: rows with children, flattened for rendering.
 */
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import type { Comparator } from './sorting';

export type RowId = string | number;

export interface TreeRow<T> {
  id: RowId;
  data: T;
  children?: TreeRow<T>[];
  expanded?: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_INDENT = 16;

/**
 * Options of {@link TreeTableModel}.
 * `childrenKey` names the property that holds nested rows.
 */
export interface TreeTableOptions {
  childrenKey: string;
  indent: number;
  sort?: Comparator<unknown>;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class TreeTableModel<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly rows: TreeRow<T>[];

  constructor(
    rows: TreeRow<T>[],
    private readonly options: TreeTableOptions = { childrenKey: 'children', indent: DEFAULT_INDENT },
  ) {
    super();
    this.rows = rows;
  }

  /** Visible rows in display order: children follow their expanded parent. */
  visibleRows(): { row: TreeRow<T>; depth: number }[] {
    const result: { row: TreeRow<T>; depth: number }[] = [];
    const visit = (rows: TreeRow<T>[], depth: number) => {
      for (const row of rows) {
        result.push({ row, depth });
        if (row.expanded && row.children) {
          visit(row.children, depth + 1);
        }
      }
    };
    visit(this.rows, 0);
    return result;
  }

  toggle(id: RowId): void {
    const row = this.find(id);
    if (row) {
      row.expanded = !row.expanded;
      this.emit('change', row);
    }
  }

  private find(id: RowId, rows: TreeRow<T>[] = this.rows): TreeRow<T> | undefined {
    for (const row of rows) {
      if (row.id === id) {
        return row;
      }
      const child = row.children ? this.find(id, row.children) : undefined;
      if (child) {
        return child;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }
}

/** Builds a model from flat records with a `parentId` (e.g. rows from a database). */
export function createTreeTableModel<T extends { id: RowId; parentId?: RowId }>(
  records: T[],
): TreeTableModel<T> {
  const byId = new Map<RowId, TreeRow<T>>();
  for (const record of records) {
    byId.set(record.id, { id: record.id, data: record, children: [] });
  }
  const roots: TreeRow<T>[] = [];
  for (const record of records) {
    const row = byId.get(record.id)!;
    const parent = record.parentId === undefined ? undefined : byId.get(record.parentId);
    (parent?.children ?? roots).push(row);
  }
  return new TreeTableModel(roots);
}
